description.value: Velofix is a mobile bike shop franchise that dispatches certified technicians directly to wherever a cyclist needs them — home, trailhead, or accommodation. With 130+ technicians across North America and over 220,000 completed services, it covers a wide range of bikes including road, gravel, mountain, commuter, triathlon, tandem, and e-bikes. For touring cyclists in BC, it offers a practical alternative to hauling a bike to a shop, bookable online or by phone.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Velofix is a mobile bike repair franchise — technicians come to the customer's location rather than operating a fixed storefront. The website confirms a full range of bike and e-bike services, with explicit e-bike packages (Silver, Gold, Flat Repair) and support for Rad Power, Benno, OHM, Yamaha, and Strome brands. No physical address or lat/lon exists because the service model is location-agnostic; the OSM record is centrally administered to cover multiple BC routes.
concerns: No physical address or lat/lon — this is a mobile service with no fixed location; directory display and map placement will require special handling.
Phone '1-855-VELOFIX' sourced from website only; OSM record contained no phone field to cross-check against.
Record covers multiple BC routes (chilliwack-loops, kvr-myra-canyon, okanagan-rail-trail, vancouver-crossing-loop) as a single centrally administered entry rather than individual location nodes.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable mobile bike service operating across BC with confirmed coverage on multiple listed routes. Always-include flag set by manual administration.
enrichment_extras.notes: Booking is done online at velofix.com or by calling 1-855-VELOFIX. Service availability varies by postal code; cyclists should confirm coverage for their specific location before relying on this listing.

E-bike service.detail: Dedicated e-bike service packages (Silver, Gold, Flat Repair) covering safety inspection, drivetrain, braking, wheel truing, and electrical systems; explicitly supports Rad Power, Benno, OHM, Yamaha, and Strome e-bikes

wow_evidence: mobile bike shop franchise that dispatches certified technicians
